title: undo
description: The journal, read and rewound (SDD 9.8, 7.6). action "list" reads the durable per-workspace op log — newest op first, one row per file an op touched, each row carrying the op seq, its added/removed line counts and its unified diff — and writes nothing. action "rewind" (the default) rewinds whole ops: the newest `steps`, or exactly the ops named by `ops` (the seqs `list` reports). Rewind is session-scoped by default: only the calling session's ops (identity via _meta magistr/sessionId) are candidates unless scope is "workspace". Conflicts — a later change touched a file this undo would restore — are detected by content hash and surfaced in the envelope as a three-way choice (keepCurrent | force | merge by hand), never silently clobbered. Every restoration runs through the verified write pipeline with staleness anchors.

action.description: rewind: revert ops. list: read the journal as rows; nothing is written, nothing is locked, so a change view can tail it.

steps.description: rewind: how many ops to rewind, newest first. One op = one write batch. Ignored when ops names the ops.

ops.description: rewind: the exact ops to rewind, by the journal seq that action "list" reports. A named op that is not a candidate — already undone, an undo's own op, or another session's under session scope — is named in the notes and skipped.

scope.description: session: only the calling session's ops (two agents sharing a workspace never silently revert each other). workspace: ops from any session. Defaults to session for rewind and workspace for list — reading another session's history reverts nothing.

onConflict.description: rewind: surface applies nothing and returns conflict rows with expected/current/restore hashes. force restores the journaled content over the conflicting change. keepCurrent leaves conflicted files as they are and undoes the rest.

limit.description: list: how many ops to return, newest first.

diff.description: list: render each row's unified diff. false keeps the counts and drops the bodies.

sinceSeq.description: list: only ops with seq >= this — tail the log since the last one seen.

beforeSeq.description: list: only ops with seq < this — the pagination cursor a truncated listing hands back.
